rows.issue: No site elevation, terrain, minimum hull clearance, altitude ceiling or required 500m condition has been authorised. Centre 10m is ground tangency at sea level; 100m is only an illustrative 90m clearance.
rows.next_evidence: Specify centre-height range relative to surveyed terrain, weather set, clearance and whether 500m means ISA free float or a minimum on every design day.

rows.issue: 019 specifies conditions at one altitude, not a vertical profile. A 6.5K/km lapse and constant e/p were imposed. At the 100m floor, isothermal optimistic climate mass is 11.73kg versus 55.34kg with the chosen lapse; both-weather values are 403.66 versus 441.77kg.
rows.next_evidence: Supply measured or approved temperature, pressure, humidity and inversion profiles, including joint extremes and occurrence probabilities.

rows.issue: The conservative high-pressure humid day becomes supersaturated in the all-weather 500m-floor diagnostic. The 0/10/100m-floor main cases are unsaturated in the stated model. Continuing an unsaturated lapse through cloud is not a physical forecast.
rows.next_evidence: Use a moist atmospheric profile with cloud/condensate treatment; do not treat that diagnostic height as an operational guarantee.

rows.issue: A fixed evacuated hull has one passive equilibrium per weather profile and carried load. Positive C raises its ISA float altitude; C=0 cannot float at 500m ISA and satisfy the illustrative sea-level-ground clearance on both 019 hot-day extremes. Static equilibrium does not provide station keeping.
rows.next_evidence: Resolve the mission requirement; size active altitude control, tethering, launch, landing, descent-rate and gust response if needed.

rows.issue: Climate is absent mass; water, contamination and gas are carried mass. 021 rev1 has a 5% placeholder, no separate climate rows or explicit seam budget. Recasting that placeholder is a new budget assumption.
rows.next_evidence: Approve one common itemised gross mass ledger, including payload status, before treating cross-card points as the same vehicle.

rows.issue: SR-200 345MPa is a tensile minimum transferred to compression. The 379.2MPa endpoint is a historical lot result; continuous interpolated strength is not a procureable design allowable. 021 rev1 inherits 283MPa at E290GPa.
rows.next_evidence: Obtain gauge-, direction-, lot-, temperature- and post-form compression and modulus allowables.

rows.issue: The least-set P2 points need multi-metre square-equivalent panels at roughly 0.65–0.72mm face gauge. The nominal today 0.9144m seam-equivalent stock size is itself not established at those gauges.
rows.next_evidence: Supplier-confirm formed sheet sizes, gauges, thickness distribution, yield and joining geometry.

rows.issue: The hemisphere-derived 0.2/1 branch rule and 018 interpolation to 0.2+0.4min(Vc,2) have not been validated for the complete sphere. Numerical least-set membership is conditional on these bounds.
rows.next_evidence: Correlate full-shell imperfection-sensitive nonlinear analysis and representative structural testing.

rows.issue: Wrinkle coefficients between 0.33 and 0.82 and published typical core properties are used for a curved sandwich. The catalogue includes transferred moduli and scaled cores; the winner is the sourced light 5056 core, but no assembly allowable exists.
rows.next_evidence: Test curvature, cell depth, orthotropy, face/core bond and biaxial wrinkling/crimp/crush/dimpling at service temperature.

rows.issue: P2 seams and bond films are a mass recipe, not checked structural joints. P3 percent joints are an allowance, not strength or rotational stiffness. Folded source joints sized at p0 cannot automatically take a larger float pressure.
rows.next_evidence: Size and qualify seal, splice, node and load-introduction details at the maximum service pressure, including stiffness, eccentricity, fatigue and leakage.

rows.issue: The passing P3 keeps a 3900MPa SiC tube compression value, 410GPa modulus, 1.5GPa/970kg/m3 film and metre-scale thin curved tubes. These are not a demonstrated assembly or a safe tensile/bending allowable.
rows.next_evidence: Carry tube-scale brittle reliability, post-form flaw statistics, film biaxial/creep/UV/seam/barrier properties and manufacture into the model.

rows.issue: FIX-A triangular load sharing is used. FIX-B SP-8007 axial-cylinder knockdown is transferred to curved ceramic members; Perry and k=0.2 global continuum equations remain inherited idealisations.
rows.next_evidence: Validate curved member local buckling, imperfections, ceramic tension/compression interaction and discrete-frame modes with actual node stiffness.

rows.issue: 022b's s/(16R) displacement loss is applied as reduced volume at every altitude. Film shape may change with pressure, and the spherical arc/member model is approximate for 6m bays on R10m.
rows.next_evidence: Solve coupled membrane shape, true enclosed volume, pressure and frame load path; verify the global continuum approximation and spacing bounds.

rows.issue: Mode scores use uniform centre pressure, no internal-pressure relief and fixed material properties. Local bottom pressure is about a further 0.1% higher, while gradients, thermal mismatch, wind, attached loads and descent transients are unscored.
rows.next_evidence: Set structural design factors and loads independently of the SF=1 screening threshold; include nonuniform pressure and thermal/wind/handling loads.

rows.issue: The calculation retains optimistic 019 nonclimate loads and the full 100kg system floor even on conservative weather. This isolates weather; it does not qualify the conservative pump/battery/rain/contamination hardware package.
rows.next_evidence: Qualify 24h sealed service and internal gas inventory, or recalculate with measured leakage, pumping, rain/ice retention and all installed systems.
